title: CustomerQualityInput
description: Cleaner adapter wire shape — `{ row, window_tail }`. The cleaner invokes this tool once per row in the L1 window; the response feeds into the anomaly-rule pipeline (`builtin.nan` → `builtin.spike` → `builtin.stuck` → this rule).

row.description: The L1 row under inspection. Free-form for the CSV demo; the cleaner builtins assume a numeric `value` column but this rule inspects datablist-shaped customer fields.

window_tail.description: Recent rows for the same entity (cleaner-supplied context). Unused by this rule.
